    What is the meaning of Adame?
    The name Adame is primarily a male name with Hebrew origins, derived from the name Adam. Its meaning is "son of the red earth" or simply "man." In the Bible, Adam is the name of the first man created by God, making the name deeply rooted in religious and cultural significance.Aug 4, 2025

    What is the ethnicity of the last name Adame?
    The most commonly-observed ancestry found in people with the surname Adame is Indigenous American, which comprises 34.7% of all ancestry found in people with the surname. The next two most common ancestries are Spanish & Portuguese (33.6%) and British & Irish (12.7%).

    What is Alfredo Adame known for?
    Alfredo Adame was born on June 10, 1958 in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. He is an actor and producer, known for De frente al sol (1992), Mi segunda madre (1989) and Retrato de familia (1995). He is married to Mary Paz Banquells. They have three children.
